issues.description: The default FIX_LEN (which determines the underlying type/size of fix_t) is inconsistent between the test harness and the example program in the template repository. tests/src/math_fix.h defines FIX_LEN as 4 (32-bit fix_t) while example_program/src/math_fix.h defines FIX_LEN as 8 (64-bit fix_t). The solution repository uses FIX_LEN = 8 in its tests. This mismatch means students may compile and run tests that expect a different fix_t size than the example program and the reference solution, causing confusing type/calling-convention differences and spurious failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make FIX_LEN consistent across the template (tests and example_program) and align it with the solution (preferably FIX_LEN = 8 as used in the example_program and solution). Concretely, update tests/src/math_fix.h in the template to define FIX_LEN 8 (or update example_program to use 4) and add a clear note in problem_statement.md documenting the required FIX_LEN for the assignment so students know which fixed-point width to target.
